description: This file defines the UserIdleProcessor class for user inactivity detection and timeout handling in the Pipecat project. It manages callbacks triggered after user inactivity, processes relevant frames, and handles asynchronous idle timeout monitoring.

classes.name: UserIdleProcessor
classes.description: A processor that monitors user inactivity, triggers callbacks after specified timeouts, and manages related frame processing.

methods.name: _wrap_callback
methods.description: Wraps a callback to support both basic and retry signature patterns, returning a function that always takes processor and retry count.

methods.name: _create_idle_task
methods.description: Creates the asynchronous idle monitoring task if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: retry_count
methods.description: Property that returns the current number of times the idle callback has been triggered.

methods.name: _stop
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the idle monitoring task.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, manages state transitions, and starts/stops idle monitoring based on conversation activity.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops idle task when shutting down.

methods.name: _idle_task_handler
methods.description: Asynchronous loop that waits for idle timeout and triggers the callback if user remains inactive.
